method.cache: Warm Windows cache. One unmeasured startup process and one in-process navigation warm-up.
method.startup: Time to the first DWM-flushed paint from a dispatched window message. One process per sample.
method.navigation: App-internal timings in one visible process. Dispatch reports the longest sampled message dispatch for each navigation.
method.measurement_limits: App timings do not independently verify desktop composition, queued message delivery or real input latency. Windows scheduling and background activity affect the samples.
method.idle: Process CPU time divided by elapsed time, expressed as a percent of one logical core.
method.fixture: Zero-length text files in local temporary directories.
